acropolis-stair.role: Principal ceremonial stair between the Council terrace and the clan audience court
acropolis-stair.populationRule: Keep the walking center free; attendants remain on the existing terraces, never inside the transit line
acropolis-stair.decorationRule: Bronze side structure and restrained amber beacons belong to the native drawing; no extra invisible rail collider is created

lower-gallery-stair.role: Dedicated shorter broad stair from the lower service street into the galleries
lower-gallery-stair.populationRule: No crowd, cage or workshop prop occupies the two existing landing centers
lower-gallery-stair.decorationRule: Native gallery scale and passage width; never a horizontally stretched acropolis stair

clan-lift.role: Dedicated delegation lift between the civic level and the Council terrace
clan-lift.populationRule: Keep the two level sockets and the cabin approach clear; waiting delegates remain on the existing terraces
clan-lift.decorationRule: Dedicated stationary gantry and cabin architecture, never an elevator renamed from a stair; static source is not a native moving-cabin sheet

service-ramp.role: Native ascending-right maintenance connection from the workshops to the lower galleries
service-ramp.populationRule: No crate, service cart or worker blocks either current landing center
service-ramp.decorationRule: The diagonal orientation belongs to the native drawing; no screen rotation, mirror, shear or width/height stretch

industrial-ramp.role: Industrial pedestrian ramp between the lower service street and the workshops under the city
industrial-ramp.populationRule: Workshop workers and cargo stay on existing forecourts outside the two landing centers
industrial-ramp.decorationRule: Continuous solid support and side service structure come from the native drawing; no freestanding modern road furniture

slum-slope.role: Reuse of the industrial pedestrian module for the long public descent into the lower service street
slum-slope.populationRule: Maintain the two existing landing centers and their walking approach; no cargo stack inside the center passage
slum-slope.decorationRule: The shared material belongs to the same city infrastructure; no new district or campaign reward is implied
